title: Arrows

# Arrows

# Introduction

Arrows is a type of ammunition for Bows.
Arrow damage is added to base bow damage before any other damage calculation. (See Damage mechanics for details).
If you have more than one kind of arrow, you can right click the kind you want in your inventory.
